      "evidence": "Significantly refactors BIP32 utilities in src/util/bip32.cpp and src/util/bip32.h by adding KeyPath and KeyPathElement classes.",

      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Promotes BIP32 derivation paths to KeyPath and KeyPathElement classes to retain multipath branch specifications and hardening notation. This expands utility primitives cleanly for node-wide path handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",

      "reason_tag": "unblocks #36443",
      "rationale": "Refactors descriptor parsing to natively represent multipath descriptors in a single object instead of discarding them into distinct vectors, unblocking downstream multipath wallet support. As the author notes, previously 'multipath elements are lost as the result is the multiple distinct descriptors that the multipath is a shorthand for', and this architectural change directly enables #36443 and #36444."
